qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | pgt (hindi): Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institution/University in Hindi with at least 50% marks in aggregate including B.Ed. component OR Master Degree in Hindi with at least 50% marks in aggregate AND B.Ed. Degree (or equivalent integrated degrees) from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks. Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English medium. | pgt (mathematics): Integrated Post Graduate Course from NCTE recognized institution/University in Mathematics with at least 50% marks in aggregate including B.Ed. component OR Master Degree in Mathematics/specialization with studied Mathematics at graduation level with at least 50% marks in aggregate AND B.Ed. Degree (or equivalent integrated degrees) from NCTE recognized institution with at least 50% marks. Proficiency to teach in Hindi and English medium. | tgt (maths): Four years integrated degree course from NCTE recognized Institution with at least 50% marks in concerned subject(s) and aggregate including B.Ed component OR Bachelor/Honours Degree with at least 50% marks in concerned subject, combination of subjects and aggregate AND B.Ed. Degree (or 3-year B.Ed.-M.Ed. or 1-year B.Ed. Special Education) with at least 50% marks OR Post-Graduation in concerned subject/specialization with minimum 55% marks with graduation level subjects and 3-year B.Ed.-M.Ed. AND Qualified in CTET Paper-II conducted by CBSE. Competency to teach through English and Hindi Medium. Candidates must have studied Mathematics as Elective/Main in at least 3 years/06 semesters, Physics at least 1 year/02 semesters, and one out of Chemistry, Electronics, Computer Science, Statistics at least 1 year/02 semesters. B.Sc. (Hons) in Physics or Chemistry are not eligible. | primary teacher: Senior Secondary/Higher Secondary/Intermediate (10+2) with at least 50% marks and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education OR 4-year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed.) OR 2-year Diploma in Education (Special Education) from RCI AND Qualified in CTET Paper-I conducted by CBSE. Proficiency to teach through Hindi & English. | special educator (primary): XIIth passed and two year D.Ed. Special Education in any disability category OR one year Diploma in Special Education (DSE) OR Diploma in Community Based Rehabilitation (DCBR) with 6 months Certificate course OR Post Graduate Diploma in Community Based Rehabilitation (PGDCBR) with 6 months certificate course OR Diploma in Multi Rehabilitation Worker (MRW) with 6 months Certificate course OR Junior Diploma in Teaching the Deaf OR Primary level Teacher Training course in Visual Impairment OR DVR-MR/DVTE-MR with 6 months Certificate OR DHLS with 6 months Certificate OR XII passed with RCI recognized qualification of minimum one year duration and 6 months Certificate course in Education of Children with Special Needs OR any other equivalent qualification approved by RCI AND CTET Qualified. | yoga teacher: Bachelor's Degree in Physical Education (B.P.Ed) or Bachelor's Degree in any subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate AND a Diploma in Yoga from a recognized university or institute. Proficiency to teach through Hindi & English. | counsellor: B.A. / B.Sc. (Psychology) with at least 50% marks in aggregate from government recognized institute/university with Certificate of Diploma in Counselling.

selection_process: The selection process comprises Document Verification and Interview.
how_to_apply: Register on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal (https://samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in).
Visit the official KV Bijapur website (https://bijapur.kvs.ac.in) to access the notification and download the application form.
Fill out separate application forms if applying for multiple posts.
Attach self-attested Xerox copies of all certificates and mark sheets of all years separately along with passport size photographs.
Bring the filled application form, self-attested copies, and original documents for verification during registration at the school premises on 12 October 2026 between 8:30 AM and 10:00 AM.
important_instructions: Candidates must register between 8:30 AM and 10:00 AM on 12 October 2026; late entry will not be entertained. Priority for teaching posts will be given to B.Ed. and CTET or TET qualified candidates, with non-CTET/B.Ed. candidates considered only in their absence. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Contractual appointment confers no right or claim for regular appointment or cadre membership. Teachers appointed on contract are not entitled to vacation pay; payments during Autumn/Winter breaks and absences are calculated on a pro rata basis as per KVS norms. Candidates must possess working knowledge of computers and capability to teach in hybrid mode using platforms like Google Classroom, Google Meet, and Classroom live. Every teacher must adhere to the prescribed neat and dignified dress code while on duty.

faq.question: Q1. What is KV Bijapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: KV Bijapur Recruitment 2026 is a walk-in interview process conducted by Kendriya Vidyalaya Bijapur to form a contractual panel of teachers and support staff for the academic session 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under this notification?
faq.answer: The available posts include PGT (Hindi, Mathematics), TGT (Mathematics), Primary Teacher, Counsellor, Special Educator (Primary), and Yoga Coach.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and registration are scheduled for 12 October 2026 (Monday), with registration taking place from 8:30 AM to 10:00 AM and interviews starting at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q4. Where will the interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview and registration will be held at the Kendriya Vidyalaya Bijapur premises, Kotapal, Near Gyanagudi, Bijapur (Chhattisgarh).

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 65 years as on the date of interview.
